yaml:
apiVersion: unified-cd/v1
kind: Job
metadata:
  name: edge-call-parent
spec:
  native: true
  agentSelector:
    - kind:linux
  steps:
    - name: prelude
      run: for i in $(seq 1 20); do echo "parent,$i,$(date -u +%H:%M:%S)" >> /data/parent.log; sleep 1; done
    - name: invoke_child
      call:
        job: edge-call-child
